### What worked

- [ ] Connects
- [ ] Live view
- [ ] Exposure settings (aperture, shutter, ISO, exposure compensation, white balance)
- [ ] Autofocus / click to focus
- [ ] Power zoom (power-zoom lenses only)
- [ ] Shoot: RAW + JPEG saved to the Mac and the card

### What didn't

Anything off: missing or wrong values, errors shown at the bottom of the window, crashes. Screenshots help.
